purpose: Advisories (npm and NuGet) that the dependency gate tools/audit/audit-gate.mjs tolerates for now. An entry is a dated decision, not a permanent exception. Rules and routine: docs/06-engineering-process.md section 4.

entryFormat.advisory: GHSA id exactly as the report prints it, e.g. GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx
entryFormat.package: the vulnerable package, not the package that depends on it
entryFormat.severity: what the report says, for the reader (the gate matches on advisory and package)
entryFormat.reason: why it is acceptable and what would end it: at least 30 characters, say why it cannot reach a shopper or staff user, and what fix you are waiting for
entryFormat.acceptedBy: the person who accepted it (GitHub username)
entryFormat.acceptedOn: YYYY-MM-DD, the UTC date (the gate compares with the UTC day; in Sri Lanka that is yesterday between 00:00 and 05:30)
entryFormat.reviewBy: YYYY-MM-DD, after acceptedOn and no more than 90 days after it; the gate fails the day after this date
entryFormat.issue: optional: the GitHub issue that tracks removing it

notes: Only HIGH and CRITICAL advisories need an entry; the gate ignores the rest.

A NuGet advisory also fails restore in the build jobs (warnings are errors). Accepting one needs a NuGetAuditSuppress item as well, which is a coordinated change to Directory.Build.props or Directory.Packages.props; the suppression alone does not satisfy this gate.
The gate fails on an entry whose advisory is no longer reported. Delete it, do not leave it to pre-approve the next advisory.

No overrides and no accepted npm advisories since #272 (2026-11-05). @angular/cli 21.2.29 depends on @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.32.1 itself, so the #226 override was removed; @angular/build 21.2.29 ships vite 7.3.7 and undici 7.30.1 (framework packages moved to 21.2.26 as a set, because npm resolves compiler-cli and the optional peers at 21.2.26, which pin the framework to that patch); node-gyp's undici and express's body-parser moved in range to 6.29.1 and 2.4.0. That made all three entries stale and they were deleted: vite GHSA-587h-7wmj-h5pm, undici GHSA-xjj6-f33q-929c and body-parser GHSA-27r3-jxmh-p828 (the last was described as extraneous, but it is express's dependency and ships in the SSR server bundle; not exploitable only because server.ts mounts no body parser). Check `npm view @angular/build@21 dependencies` and `npm view @angular/cli@21 dependencies` at every Angular tooling bump.
